d:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio delivered a keynote address at the Federalist Society National Lawyers Convention in Washington, D.C., on November 13, 2026. During his remarks, Rubio took a swipe at Democrats over their threats against President Donald Trump, delivering a pointed one-liner that drew attention. His comments come amid continuing political and legal battles surrounding the Trump administration. Watch Rubio's address and his sharp remarks at the convention.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
